items.title: Snowflake CoCo AI 成本优化指南：7 个关键方法 | 技术实践
items.summary_zh: Snowflake CoCo 能将自然语言转换为实际工作流，运行 SQL 和多步流程并调用大模型，但按 token 消耗 credits，成本容易失控。这篇文章给出从轻量监控到强制阻断的 7 个治理手段，第一步是通过 SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE 下的三个 usage history 视图统计每个用户的 credit 消耗，后续再用默认优化和硬性约束控本。适合用 CoCo 做智能体应用、需要建立成本治理的团队参考。
items.summary_en: Snowflake CoCo turns natural language into real workflows, running SQL and multi-step processes with LLM calls, but consumes credits per token and can easily blow budgets. This article walks through seven governance levers, starting with usage history views in SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE to track per-user credit consumption, then default-behavior optimization and strict constraints. It's practical guidance for teams using CoCo for agentic apps who need cost control.

The latest release is Apple macOS-certified, so no manual security overrides are needed, and it adds skills management, terminal/git integration, file preview, @file/{skill_name} skill invocation, plus beta Telegram and mobile LAN sync. Pi users who prefer a local GUI for agent work may want to try it.

items.title: 豆包视频通话升级，火山引擎多模态传输系统提供技术支撑
items.summary_zh: 豆包视频通话升级后，AI 能同时处理音视频和文本三路输入，可边看边听边说、主动开口，官方称对话节奏违和问题相比传统级联方案减少约 50%。技术底层由火山引擎多模态传输系统（MMT）支撑，基于 QUIC 和 MoQ 协议，建联耗时从秒级降至数百毫秒，并通过统一会话控制避免音视频流与模型状态异步导致的答非所问。适合关注多模态实时交互和 AI 语音助手的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: Doubao's upgraded video calling lets the AI ingest audio, video, and text simultaneously, speak when appropriate, and reduces awkward conversational pauses by about 50% versus classic cascaded systems, according to official evaluation. Underneath, Volcano Engine's MMT (multimodal transport system) replaces traditional RTC: it uses QUIC and MoQ for a unified session, cutting connection time from seconds to hundreds of milliseconds and preventing out-of-sync audio/model states. This is relevant for developers working on full-duplex multimodal real-time interaction.

items.title: [AI SaaS 产品推荐] KIE Alternatives in 2026: Seedance and MiniMax H3 Priced Per Second
items.summary_zh: KIE.ai 按 credit 计价、reAPI 按秒直接报价；按 720p 归一化后，reAPI 在所有 Seedance 档位和 MiniMax H3 上便宜 8%–25%。不过带参考视频时按输入+输出时长计费，低价档可能反而更贵，作者建议剪短参考片段。
items.summary_en: A comparison of video-generation billing between KIE.ai and reAPI, normalized at 720p, shows reAPI is cheaper on every Seedance tier and MiniMax H3, with savings from 8% to 25% (Seedance 2.0 drops from $0.205 to $0.154 per output second). The catch: reference-video requests bill input plus output seconds on both platforms, so a long reference clip can wipe out the saving. The author advises trimming the clip rather than picking a cheaper tier.

items.title: 共识之外：Linux 生态系统中 AI 政策的碎片化现象
items.summary_zh: 文章对比了 Linux 生态对 AI 生成代码的不同政策：GCC 倾向全面禁用 AI 补丁，担心版权污染和幻觉漏洞；Torvalds 要求内核维护者能解释每一行代码；Kubernetes 要求 PR 披露 AI 使用并禁止 AI 生成提交信息；Debian 则用一般决议判断其与自由软件准则的关系。这些路线展示了基础设施项目在透明度、可靠性和人类责任之间的不同取舍。
items.summary_en: The article maps how Linux ecosystem projects are fragmenting on AI policy. GCC maintainers lean toward banning AI-generated patches over copyright and hallucination risks; the Linux kernel, led by Torvalds, requires maintainers to defend every line; Kubernetes mandates AI-use disclosure in PRs and forbids AI-written commit messages; Debian is weighing AI output against its Free Software Guidelines. The article is useful for teams deciding how to integrate AI assistance into code review.

items.title: 谷歌发布 Angular v22，带来稳定的 Signal Forms、默认启用的 OnPush 以及实验性的 WebMCP
items.summary_zh: Angular v22 让 Signal Forms、Angular Aria 和 resource/rxResource/httpResource 转正，并把 OnPush 设为默认变更检测（旧默认策略改名 Eager），还带来 @Service() 装饰器、injectAsync 懒加载和模板 spread/rest 语法。官方同时实验性支持 WebMCP，把应用和表单暴露给浏览器内 AI 智能体。HN 上有人为 Signal Forms 欢呼，也有人批评编译器在 AI 编程时代拖后腿。
items.summary_en: Angular v22 stabilizes Signal Forms, Angular Aria, and resource/rxResource/httpResource, makes OnPush the default change-detection strategy (the old default is renamed Eager), and adds @Service(), injectAsync lazy loading, and template spread/rest. It also ships experimental WebMCP to expose apps and forms to browser-based AI agents. Hacker News reviewers welcome the shift from RxJS-only form handling, but many still see the Angular compiler as a bottleneck for AI-assisted development.

items.title: Stripe 利用 Graph Search 和状态机实现数据库修复自动化
items.summary_zh: Stripe 工程团队将全球 MongoDB 基础设施建模为图，结合图搜索与状态机自动计算修复路径，替代硬编码的插件式修复。采用 Dijkstra 算法后，系统能动态适应分片布局，将数据库相关寻呼告警减少约 30%，相当于每年少 200 次寻呼、消除约 12 天分片异常。适合管理复杂分布式基础设施、希望用状态机发现全新恢复方案的团队。
items.summary_en: Stripe's engineering team models its global MongoDB infrastructure as a graph and uses graph search combined with state machines to automate failure recovery. Replacing hardcoded repair sequences with Dijkstra-based pathfinding reduced database-related paging alerts by roughly 30%, saving about 200 pages and 12 days of shard anomalies per year. A useful pattern for teams managing complex distributed systems.

items.summary_en: Blume is a documentation framework that puts Markdown first and is explicitly described as AI-ready. It positions itself as a bridge between plain-Markdown docs and AI tooling, which may appeal to teams that want their documentation to be easily consumed by LLMs or retrieval pipelines. items.title: Anthropic's ‘watermark’ text adulteration in Claude is a perversion of writing
items.author: ropbear
items.summary_zh: John Gruber 在 Daring Fireball 发文批评 Anthropic 即将为所有 Claude 模型生成的内容（包括文本）打水印的做法。他最初猜测会用不可见 Unicode 字符，实际披露的方案是在推理时对词元选择施加隐写痕迹，以便日后概率性检测。Gruber 认为这是对写作的亵渎，且 Anthropic 的公告连基本实现方式都没说明。
items.summary_en: John Gruber of Daring Fireball criticizes Anthropic's plan to watermark all Claude outputs, including text, citing an EU regulation. The implementation isn't invisible Unicode characters but steganographic fingerprints in token choices during inference, enabling probabilistic detection later. Gruber argues this adulterates writing and notes Anthropic's announcement offered no explanation of how it works.

items.summary_en: Matt Pocock open-sourced his personal AI agent skills in mattpocock/skills, taken from his own .agents directory and used for real engineering, not vibe coding. Unlike frameworks like GSD, BMAD, or Spec-Kit that own the whole process, these skills are deliberately small, adaptable, composable, and model-agnostic, giving developers more control. He encourages hacking on them and making them your own.

items.summary_en: Qwen 3.8 27B is a 27B-parameter vision-language model from Alibaba's Qwen lab, released under Apache 2.0. Simon Willison found it excellent but prone to overthinking by default; it runs as a 17GB Q4_K_M quantized build on a MacBook Pro and NVIDIA DGX Spark, with benchmarks beating both Qwen 3.6 27B and closed-weight Qwen 3.7-Plus.

items.summary_en: This post links to the updated core system prompts for Claude, now available on claude.ai and the official iOS and Android apps. Developers who tune Claude or audit its behavior can read exactly what changed in the official prompts, making it a useful primary reference for understanding the model's guardrails and default instructions.

items.title: 让 Agent 真正驱动销售增长——FDE 模式下的业务流重构实战｜AICon深圳

items.summary_en: At AICon Shenzhen, running August 21–22, Alibaba Cloud principal technologist Ruan Chengfeng will present a session on turning AI agents into real sales growth via the FDE model. Drawing on cases like a car dealership's sales assistant and a pharma company's compliance assistant, the talk covers identifying high-value scenarios, unifying structured and unstructured data, and embedding agents into frontline workflows. It's aimed at engineers and business leaders exploring agent commercialization.

items.title: Embabel智能体框架发布1.0版本
items.summary_zh: Embabel 1.0 正式发布，面向 Java/Kotlin 的 AI 智能体框架，Spring 创始人 Rod Johnson 联合创建，构建在 Spring AI 之上。它用类型化目标、动作和条件声明智能体，运行时由类似游戏 AI 的 GOAP 规划器选动作序列并可重规划。适合 Java 生态中需要多模型编排、不想手写提示词的开发者。
items.summary_en: Embabel 1.0 is out as a generally available Java/Kotlin framework for building AI agents, co-created by Spring founder Rod Johnson on top of Spring AI. Developers declare typed goals, actions, and conditions; a GOAP-inspired runtime planner assembles and re-plans action sequences. Java teams wanting multi-model orchestration without hand-wiring prompts and tool calls should look here.

items.title: A Preview of DuckDB v2.0
items.author: ibotty
items.summary_zh: DuckDB 官方预告 v2.0 将于今年秋季发布，并列出主要新特性：支持作为服务器运行、触发器、VARIANT 类型、异步 I/O、新的 SQL parser 和新的存储格式。对用 DuckDB 做嵌入式分析或需要服务化部署的开发者，服务端模式值得关注。
items.summary_en: DuckDB v2.0 is scheduled for this fall, according to an official preview. The headline features include running DuckDB as a server, triggers, the VARIANT type, asynchronous I/O, a new SQL parser, and a new storage format. Developers using DuckDB for embedded analytics or planning server-side deployments should pay close attention.

items.title: How Bluesky draws its logo on screenshots
items.author: gavide
items.summary_zh: 开发者 Tim Marinin 发现，Bluesky 应用界面本没有 logo，但截图角落却会出现，同一位置在正常使用时是 Follow 按钮。他在切换应用的间隙截屏仍看到按钮，于是怀疑 Bluesky 借助 iOS 截屏监听在最后瞬间换上 logo，并为此写了分析。
items.summary_en: Developer Tim Marinin noticed that Bluesky screenshots show a logo in the corner even though the app UI doesn't display one — the spot is occupied by a Follow button. When he screenshotted during an app-switcher transition, the button was still visible, so he suspects Bluesky hooks the iOS screenshot shortcut and swaps in the logo at the last moment. He published his investigation.

items.title: Valhalla 项目首次预览：JEP 401 重新定义 Java 对象的 == 运算符
items.summary_zh: JDK 28 集成了 JEP 401 值对象预览：使用 value 修饰符的类只有 final 字段、没有对象身份，它们的 == 从引用比较改为按字段值比较，普通对象保持原语义。预览功能默认关闭，需要 --enable-preview 启用。它为更扁平的 JVM 内存布局铺路，适合关注性能的 Java 开发者。
items.summary_en: JDK 28 now includes JEP 401 in preview: value classes declared with `value` have only final fields and no identity, and their == operator compares field values rather than references, while ordinary classes keep the old behavior. The preview is off by default and requires --enable-preview. It is significant for Java developers tracking JVM flattening and allocation-free layouts.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受

items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Codex for over two weeks, the author found Codex closer to the next-generation AI programming form — not just a coding assistant but a true super agent capable of handling tasks independently. This hands-on comparison highlights a shift from code completion to autonomous agents, useful for developers evaluating AI coding tools.

items.title: Canva 分享了基于 S3 的架构，用于管理数亿个会话的会话撤销
items.summary_zh: Canva 把会话撤销数据以紧凑的二进制记录放进不可变的 S3 对象，再作为内存索引分发到网关，授权请求大多不再查数据库。新架构将撤销缓存内存占用降低 87.5%，worker 每秒可处理超 2000 次撤销，并加速部署、减少数据库基建。适合需要支撑数亿会话的团队借鉴。
items.summary_en: Canva redesigned session revocation around immutable S3 objects holding compact 16-byte records, with an in-memory index pushed to application gateways, so most auth requests no longer hit the database. The shift cut revocation cache memory by 87.5%, lets workers process 2,000+ revocations per second, and speeds deployments. Teams operating very large session fleets can learn from this S3-as-orchestration design.

items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

items.summary_en: Prelint is a linter purpose‑built for AI‑generated code, tackling the growing problem of product drift—where code compiles and runs but subtly strays from business requirements. It uses custom rules and semantic analysis to catch these mismatches before they hit production. For teams relying on AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot or OpenAI Codex, Prelint acts as a quality gate, ensuring the output aligns with actual product intent. Developers who want to accelerate with AI without sacrificing accuracy will find it an indispensable safety net. It bridges the gap between fast code generation and reliable software delivery.

items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

Its focus on simplicity and performance makes it a go-to choice for indie games and embedded tools.

items.summary_en: The original Apollo Guidance Computer source code was uploaded to GitHub, sparking a wave of tech nostalgia. For history enthusiasts and programmers, it offers a unique glimpse into how early engineers achieved spaceflight computing with minimal instructions and core memory. It's not just a historical artifact but a showcase of classic embedded system design.

The biggest pain point for AI agent developers is getting real-time, cross-platform data; Agent-Reach solves this with a single command. Whether you're building a social media analyzer, a tech trend tracker, or a content aggregator, you can now equip your AI with 'eyes' at zero cost. It's a game-changer for hobbyists and startups who previously had to rely on expensive or rate-limited APIs.

items.title: DeepSeek 居然会对用户说「我去吃饭了」「我去睡了」，为啥会出现这样的现象？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 对用户说出"我去吃饭了""我去睡了"，是因为模型在模拟人类社交惯例，而不是真的具备生理状态。这类拟人化输出通常由用户设定的人设、上下文中的角色扮演或网络语料中的高频表达触发，说明大模型的自我认知并不稳定。它提醒开发者，提示词中的角色设定会显著影响模型的回复边界。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek responding "I'm going to eat" or "I'm going to sleep" is a sign of the model mimicking human conversational routines, not actual awareness. These anthropomorphic replies occur when user-set personas, roleplay context, or chat-heavy training data steer the model. It reveals how unstable LLM self-identity can be and reminds developers that system prompts heavily shape output boundaries.

items.summary_en: Deepfakes Faceswap is an open-source deepfake software that makes face swapping and video synthesis accessible to everyone. It lowers the barrier for AI-powered content creation, allowing users to produce convincing altered videos with minimal effort. However, its ease of use also raises serious ethical and privacy concerns, as the technology can be misused for misinformation or non-consensual content. While it benefits creators and hobbyists looking to experiment with visual effects, it also calls for responsible use and legal awareness to prevent harm.
